metadata.description: Version 1 of the generated sidecar beside the cache-stable system-prompt prefix: the selected node, the declared tuning, the ordered input witnesses with the SHA-256 of the bytes as observed, the prefix digest and its segment map, and the continuation plan a runner executes per request. It is a pure function of its inputs, so it carries no timestamp, no absolute path, no host observation and no content digest for any continuation row.
The selected node's workspace-relative path, `.` for the root. Relative on purpose: an absolute checkout path would make the sidecar differ by machine.
The node's declared identity, as the lane segment markers spell it.
The operating systems the product is for, in the author's own order. Every one when the manifest declares none.
The prefix's inputs in composition order, each with the digest of exactly the bytes observed.
The ordered rows of the unconditional and gated bands. Identity, order and conditions are fixed here; the bytes are read and witnessed per request.
The selected entrypoint's node-relative path. Absent means the node declared `entrypoint = false`, so the prefix has no entrypoint segment.
SHA-256 of the generated INDEX.md bytes that fix the continuation plan's identity and order. Absent when this generation published no INDEX.
Which layer of PROP-074 #LAYERED-PREFIX these bytes are. Present from version 1 although no other layer exists yet.
Which compiled lane the node publishes. `none` is a node with no static contributions, which is a normal case and not an error.
The declared host of PROP-076 #SYS-HOST-AND-TARGET, read from the node's own manifest. Never the generating machine's operating system.
One segment's body inside the prefix bytes: the offset and length slice exactly that body, framing excluded.
Whether the end of this segment is a recommended cache breakpoint.
The path exactly as the generated INDEX.md row spells it, which is workspace-root-relative and is how a reading agent resolves it.
A gated row's condition verbatim. The runner, not the generator, decides it.
